The '''Lumbridge & Draynor Diary''' is an [[Achievement Diary]] whose tasks revolve around areas in and around [[Lumbridge]], such as [[Draynor Village]], [[Al Kharid]], [[Dorgesh-Kaan]], and [[Zanaris]].

Several skill, quest, and item requirements are needed to complete all tasks. Unless stated otherwise, [[temporary skill boost]]s can be used to meet the skill requirements.

Rewards can be claimed from [[Hatius Cosaintus]] east of [[Lumbridge Castle]]'s courtyard in [[Lumbridge]]. Tasks may be done in any order, but the previous tiers of a diary must be completed to claim rewards of the next tier.

==Easy==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Lumbridge & Draynor" data-diary-tier="Easy"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Complete a lap of the [[Draynor Village Rooftop Course|Draynor Village agility course]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|2. Slay a [[Cave bug]] beneath [[Lumbridge Swamp Caves|Lumbridge Swamp]].
|
*{{SCP|Slayer|7|link=yes}}
*[[Light source]]
*[[Rope]] if the caves haven't been entered yet
|-
|3. Have [[Archmage Sedridor|Sedridor]] teleport you to the [[Rune essence mine]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Rune Mysteries]]
|-
|4. Craft some [[water rune]]s from Essence.
|
*{{SCP|Runecraft|5|link=yes}}
*[[Pure essence|Pure]], [[Daeyalt essence|daeyalt]], or [[rune essence]]
*Access to the [[Water Altar]] ([[water talisman]]/[[water tiara|tiara]], [[elemental talisman]]/[[Elemental tiara|tiara]], or the [[Abyss]])
|-
|5. Learn your age from [[Hans]] in [[Lumbridge]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|6. Pickpocket a [[man]] or [[woman]] in [[Lumbridge]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|7. Chop and burn some [[oak logs]] in [[Lumbridge]].
|
*{{SCP|Woodcutting|15|link=yes}} and {{SCP|Firemaking|15|link=yes}}
*Any [[axe]] and [[tinderbox]]
|-
|8. Kill a [[Zombie]] in [[Draynor Sewers]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|9. Catch some [[Anchovies]] in [[Al Kharid]].
|
*{{SCP|Fishing|15|link=yes}}
*[[Small fishing net]]
|-
|10. Bake some [[Bread]] on the [[Cooking range (Lumbridge Castle)|Lumbridge kitchen range]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Cook's Assistant]]
*[[Bread dough]], multiple recommended in case of [[Burnt bread|burning]] one (always successful at {{SCP|Cooking|34|link=yes}})
|-
|11. Mine some [[Iron ore]] at the [[Al Kharid mine]].
|
*{{SCP|Mining|15|link=yes}}
*Any [[pickaxe]]
|-
|12. Enter the [[H.A.M. Hideout]].
|
*None, though a [[lockpick]] is recommended
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Explorer's ring 1]]:
**Can restore 50% of [[Energy|run energy]] twice a day
**Allows 30 casts of [[Low Level Alchemy]] without [[runes]] each day (no experience granted unless done at the [[Alchemist's Playground]], still requires 21 [[Magic]])
*[[Antique lamp (easy)|Antique lamp]] worth 2,500 experience in any skill level of at least level 30

''Note: Use the [[earth rune]]s you brought on the altar, do not use the essence.
|
*{{SCP|Runecraft|23|link=y}}
*[[Earth talisman]], [[earth runes]], and [[Pure essence|pure]] or [[daeyalt essence]]
*Access to the [[Fire Altar]] ([[fire talisman]]/[[fire tiara|tiara]], [[elemental talisman]]/[[Elemental tiara|tiara]], or the [[Abyss]])
*[[Binding necklace]] recommended to guarantee the runes are successfully crafted
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Explorer's ring 2]]:
**Can restore 50% of [[Energy|run energy]] three times a day
**Three daily teleports to the [[cabbage]] patch of [[South Falador Farm]]
*[[Antique lamp (medium)|Antique lamp]] worth 7,500 experience in any skill of at least level 40

==Hard==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Lumbridge & Draynor" data-diary-tier="Hard"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Cast [[Bones to Peaches]] in [[Al Kharid palace]].
''Note: Using the [[Bones to peaches (tablet)|Bones to Peaches tablet]] does not count.
|
*{{SCP|Magic|60|link=y}}
*Access to [[Bones to Peaches]] via the [[Mage Training Arena]]
*[[Bones]] and means to cast [[Bones to Peaches]] ({{RuneReq|Nature=2|Earth=4|Water=4}})
|-
|2. Squeeze past the [[Jutting_wall_(Zanaris)#Medium|jutting wall]] on your way to the [[cosmic altar]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Lost City]]
*{{SCP|Agility|46|link=y}}
*[[Dramen staff|Dramen]] or [[Lunar staff]] to enter [[Zanaris]], or access to the [[Abyss]]
|-
|3. Craft 56 [[Cosmic runes]] simultaneously from Essence without the use of [[Runic extract|Extracts]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Lost City]]
*{{SCP|Runecraft|59|link=y}}
*28 [[Pure essence|pure]] or [[daeyalt essence]] (less may suffice with [[Raiments of the Eye]] pieces){{efn|To guarantee the task completes, bring at least 26 essence with 1 piece, 24 with 2 pieces, 22 with 3 pieces, or 19 with the full [[Raiments of the Eye]] set.}}
*Access to the [[Cosmic Altar]] ([[cosmic talisman]]/[[Cosmic tiara|tiara]], [[catalytic talisman]]/[[Catalytic tiara|tiara]], or the [[Abyss]])
|-
|4. Travel from [[Lumbridge]] to [[Edgeville]] on a [[Waka Canoe]].
|
*{{SCP|Woodcutting|57|link=y}}
*Any [[axe]]
|-
|5. Collect at least 100 [[Tears of Guthix (minigame)|Tears of Guthix]] in one visit.
''Note: This [[Tears of Guthix (minigame)|minigame]] can only be tried once a week, so be aware. Each [[quest point]] increases the time you can spend collecting tears by one [[game tick]]. It's recommended to have at least 150 quest points before trying this task. See the [[Tears of Guthix (minigame)]]'' page ''for other strategies you can use to maximize points.'' 
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Tears of Guthix (quest)|Tears of Guthix]]
*[[Games necklace]] recommended for quick access
|-
|6. Take the [[Dorgesh-Kaan–Keldagrim train system|train]] from [[Dorgesh-Kaan]] to [[Keldagrim]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Another Slice of H.A.M.]]
|-
|7. Purchase some [[Barrows gloves]] from the [[Culinaromancer's Chest|Lumbridge bank chest]]{{sic}}.
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Full completion of [[Recipe for Disaster]]
*130,000 [[coins]]
|-
|8. Pick some [[Belladonna]] from the [[farming patch]] at [[Draynor Manor]].
|
*{{SCP|Farming|63|link=y}}
*[[Belladonna seed]], [[seed dibber]], [[spade]], [[rake]] and any [[gloves]]
|-
|9. Light your [[mining helmet]] in the [[Lumbridge castle]] basement.
|
*{{SCP|Firemaking|65|link=y}}
*[[Tinderbox]] and [[mining helmet]]
|-
|10. Recharge your [[prayer]] at [[Emir's Arena]] with [[Smite]] activated.
|
*{{SCP|Prayer|52|link=y}}
|-
|11. Craft, string and enchant an [[Amulet of Power]] in [[Lumbridge]].
''Note: Doing this upstairs in [[Lumbridge Castle]] does not count.''
|
*{{SCP|Crafting|70|link=y}} and {{SCP|Magic|57|link=y}}
*[[Gold bar]], [[Diamond|cut diamond]], [[amulet mould]], [[ball of wool]]
*Means to cast [[Lvl-4 Enchant]] ({{RuneReq|Cosmic=1|Earth=10}})
|}
{{Notelist}}

===Rewards===
*[[Explorer's ring 3]]:
**Can restore 50% of [[Energy|run energy]] four times a day
**Unlimited teleports to the [[cabbage]] patch of [[South Falador Farm]]
*[[Antique lamp (hard)|Antique lamp]] worth 15,000 experience in any skill level of at least level 50
*10% increased experience from [[Tears of Guthix (minigame)|Tears of Guthix]]

|-

|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of all quests
*[[Quest point cape]]
|}
{{Notelist}}

===Rewards===
*[[Explorer's ring 4]]:
**Can restore full [[Energy|run energy]] three times a day
**Allows 30 casts of [[High Level Alchemy]] without [[runes]] each day (no experience granted unless done at the [[Alchemist's Playground]], still requires 55 [[Magic]])
*[[Antique lamp (elite)|Antique lamp]] worth 50,000 experience in any skill of at least level 70
*20% discount on items in the [[Culinaromancer's Chest]]
*Steal twice as many [[cave goblin wire]]s in [[Dorgesh-Kaan]]
*Ability to use [[fairy rings]] without the need of a [[Dramen staff|Dramen]] or [[Lunar staff]]
*Unlocks the seventh slot for blocking [[Slayer task|Slayer tasks]]
